openTeamily_base.note: main after PR #21 (upstream DS-Bot v0.3.6), which this import merged onto. Merged as PR #20 (5659f2bb27831da1c8a16e689ee8af46541d67cd).

exclude_rules: Whole-repository copy rejected; first import is a minimal needed set (see docs/upstream/SELECTION.md).
plugins/project/, plugins/timeline/, plugins/tree/, plugins/workflow/ — not first-import default core (optional later path).
ds-bot/, patches/ — unpatched upstream + regeneration patches; runtime package is core/.
Official Dockerfile and compose.yaml — pack excluded plugins and cannot be built without DSH.
ThinkFlowLab process automation (.github, .claude, policy, changelog, decisions, AGENTS, autonomous-dev, interop/live-e2e, reports).
docs/images/*, docs/assets/wechat-group.png — unverified logos, demos, QR.
Repo-root helper scripts, core/dev benches/evals/UI-shot tooling, install-doctor (references unimported plugins).
docs/index.html — marketing pages site that depends on excluded assets.
.github/ — upstream workflows that would not run from this nested path.
scripts/install.sh — clones the full upstream Bot Social repo; not appropriate for this snapshot.
scripts/demo.ts, scripts/mcp-smoke.ts — optional demos, not required by the imported service or its tests.

not_imported.dsh_npm_or_git: DeepSeek Harness / @deepseek-ai/* packages and lock closures are not vendored.
not_imported.claude_payloads: Anthropic Claude Agent SDK / Claude Code binaries are not imported.
not_imported.base_images: node:24-bookworm-slim and Debian system packages are not imported.
not_imported.project_timeline_source: plugins/project, plugins/timeline, plugins/tree and plugins/workflow are omitted from this first import; see docs/upstream/OPTIONAL-PLUGINS.md.
not_imported.trademark_assets: FlyBot docs/images/* and wechat QR; Bot Social docs/assets/*.

historical_flybot_core_pin.note: The FlyBot v0.1.5 core fork that recorded this pin was dropped from runtime/flybot/. OpenTeamily tracks upstream DS-Bot v0.3.6 in runtime/ds-bot-upstream/.
